function line(ctx,x1,y1,x2,y2,c,w=2){ctx.strokeStyle=c;ctx.lineWidth=w;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x1,y1);ctx.lineTo(x2,y2);ctx.stroke();}
function ring(ctx,x,y,r,color,w=2,opacity=1){if(!Number.isFinite(r)||r<=0)return;ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha*=opacity;ctx.strokeStyle=color;ctx.lineWidth=w;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,r,0,TAU);ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();}
function star(ctx,x,y,r,color,rot=0,prongs=4){ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y);ctx.rotate(rot);ctx.shadowColor=color;ctx.shadowBlur=12;ctx.fillStyle=color;ctx.strokeStyle='#eaffff';ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.beginPath();for(let k=0;k<prongs*2;k++){const a=k*Math.PI/prongs-Math.PI/2,m=k%2?r*.34:r;const X=Math.cos(a)*m,Y=Math.sin(a)*m;k?ctx.lineTo(X,Y):ctx.moveTo(X,Y);}ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();}
function spark(ctx,x,y,size,color,rot=0){ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y);ctx.rotate(rot);ctx.globalAlpha=.9;ctx.strokeStyle=color;ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-size,0);ctx.lineTo(size,0);ctx.moveTo(0,-size);ctx.lineTo(0,size);ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();}
function chain(ctx,x1,y1,x2,y2,color,t=0){const dx=x2-x1,dy=y2-y1,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1,angle=Math.atan2(dy,dx);ctx.save();ctx.translate(x1,y1);ctx.rotate(angle);ctx.shadowColor=color;ctx.shadowBlur=9;ctx.strokeStyle=color;ctx.lineWidth=2.3;const n=Math.ceil(d/11);for(let j=0;j<n;j++){ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(j*11,Math.sin(j*.95+t*3)*1.4,8.3,3.4,j%2?Math.PI/2:0,0,TAU);ctx.stroke();}ctx.restore();}
function glow(ctx,x,y,r,color,alpha=.3){ctx.save();const gr=ctx.createRadialGradient(x,y,0,x,y,r);gr.addColorStop(0,color);gr.addColorStop(1,'transparent');ctx.globalAlpha=alpha;ctx.fillStyle=gr;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,r,0,TAU);ctx.fill();ctx.restore();}
function spiral(ctx,x,y,r,turns,t,color,w=3){ctx.save();ctx.strokeStyle=color;ctx.lineWidth=w;ctx.shadowColor=color;ctx.shadowBlur=13;ctx.beginPath();for(let i=0;i<130;i++){const u=i/129,a=t+u*turns*TAU,rad=r*Math.pow(u,1.08);const px=x+Math.cos(a)*rad,py=y+Math.sin(a)*rad;i?ctx.lineTo(px,py):ctx.moveTo(px,py);}ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();}
function sphere(ctx,id,v,x,y,size,t,opt={}){
 const im=images.get(id+':'+v);if(!im||!im.complete||!im.naturalWidth)return false;
 ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y);
 // A hover pulse moves the model in world space; tier ornament rotates independently.
 const hover=1+Math.sin(t*2.7+id*.11)*.025;

 ctx.rotate(angle);const s=size*hover;
 glow(ctx,0,0,s*.47,COL[id-39],v===3?.18:.095);
 ctx.drawImage(im,-s/2,-s/2,s,s);
 ctx.restore();return true;
}
function ornaments(ctx,id,v,x,y,size,t){

 }else if(id===40){for(let i=0;i<3+v;i++){const a=t*.8+i*TAU/(3+v),rr=r*1.12;glow(ctx,x+Math.cos(a)*rr,y+Math.sin(a)*rr,5+2*Math.sin(t+i)**2,color,.35);}}

 else if(id===42){for(let i=0;i<3+v;i++){const a=t*.9+i*TAU/(3+v),d=r*.8+8*Math.sin(t+i);glow(ctx,x+Math.cos(a)*d,y+Math.sin(a)*d,17,color,.16);}}

 else if(id===44){spiral(ctx,x,y,r*(v===3?1.45:v===2?1.28:.72),1.9+v*.25,t*1.8,color,v===3?3.3:2);}
 else if(id===45){for(let i=0;i<8+v*3;i++){const a=i*TAU/(8+v*3)+t*.09;line(ctx,x+Math.cos(a)*r*.9,y+Math.sin(a)*r*.9,x+Math.cos(a)*r*1.13,y+Math.sin(a)*r*1.13,color,1.7);}}
 else if(id===46){const a=t*6;spark(ctx,x+size*.08,y-size*.25,6+3*Math.sin(t*8)**2,'#fff4b4',a);}

 else if(id===48){const a=t*1.55;for(let i=0;i<v;i++){const k=a+i*TAU/v;spark(ctx,x+Math.cos(k)*r*1.3,y+Math.sin(k)*r*1.3,7,color,t);}}
 else if(id===49){ring(ctx,x,y,r*1.23+Math.sin(t*4)*2,color,2,.7);}

function drawBall(ctx,id,v,x,y,size,t,opt={}){
 if(!IDS.includes(id))return false;

function opponent(ctx,x,y,r,t,lit=false){

function scene(ctx,id,v,t,width,height){const W=width||ctx.canvas.width,H=height||ctx.canvas.height;

function decorateCombat(ctx,g){if(!g)return;ctx.save();const t=g.rt||0;

   if(id===44&&o.fibSpiral){spiral(ctx,o.x,o.y,42+v*6,2.2,t*2.6,'#ffc867',2.4);if(v===3&&o.fibCount===0)ring(ctx,o.x,o.y,55,'#ffd982',4);}
   if(id===47&&v>1&&en){const a=t*1.75;for(let j=0;j<3;j++){const k=a+j*TAU/3,lineX=o.x+Math.cos(k)*32,lineY=o.y+Math.sin(k)*32;if(j===1)line(ctx,lineX,lineY,en.x,en.y,COL[id-39],1.5);}}
   if(id===48&&o.medicStation){ring(ctx,o.medicStation.x,o.medicStation.y,25+Math.sin(t*4)*4,'#84f8fc',3);}
   if(id===49&&o.mirrorEnds>t){ring(ctx,o.x,o.y,(o.r||17)+17+Math.sin(t*5)*3,COL[id-39],4);}

 }
 ctx.restore();}

function dummyClock(id,t){
 if(id!==54)return t;
